column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a NUL after more than a pipe's 64 KB of rows refuses the table all the same, in one stderr line naming it
a NUL refuses the whole table: with it in a comment between two met controls on clean lines neither runs and --gate exits 2, where without it both run and pass
and felix_qualify_run refuses it so without the caller's pipefail
and in that locale the library reads no row of it and exits non-zero
and missing_controls refuses it so without the caller's pipefail
and needs refuses such a table without the caller's pipefail too
and plain felix qualify over each of those tables runs no control, says the table holds a NUL, and exits 2
and ungoverned refuses it so without the caller's pipefail
felix gate over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere fails qualified, never ok, and shows under it the felix: line naming the table and its NUL
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL after a row's fifth field runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL alone on a line runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL inside a comment runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL inside a held row's mutation runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL past byte 8000 runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL starting a held row runs no control, says on a felix: line naming the table that it holds a NUL, and exits 2
felix_qualify_missing_controls over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere prints nothing, exits 2, and says in one stderr line naming the table that it holds a NUL
felix_qualify_rows, felix_qualify_malformed and felix_qualify_snapshot each exit non-zero over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere, with the caller's pipefail and without
felix_qualify_run over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere runs nothing, prints nothing, exits 2, and says in one stderr line naming the table that it holds a NUL
felix_qualify_ungoverned over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere names no checker, exits 2, and says in one stderr line naming the table that it holds a NUL
in a UTF-8 locale, felix qualify --gate over a table with a NUL right after a UTF-8 lead byte runs no control, says it holds a NUL, and exits 2
needs over a table holding a NUL byte anywhere resolves nothing, exits 2, and says in one stderr line naming the table that it holds a NUL
